visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit, high-tech flight simulator cabin characterized by vibrant purple and blue ambient lighting. A young girl wearing a teal t-shirt with a shark graphic and an adult woman in a black baseball cap and t-shirt are seated side-by-side in mechanical chairs with lap bars. They smile and wave energetically at the camera, their expressions filled with excitement. (2) The scene transitions to a bright mall interior featuring a large digital screen displaying a landscape. The woman and girl are seen running joyfully toward the entrance of the i-Ride TAIPEI facility. The girl's pigtails bounce as she moves. Nearby, there is a mascot character cutout and a banner for the Toy Planet adventure. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a promotional flyer for the 2025 i-Ride Parent-Child Card held on a display stand. The girl is then seen standing at a customer service desk where she looks up curiously while a staff member processes paperwork. (4) The girl is shown playing with an interactive display that resembles a large washing machine with a claw arm and an orange ball on top. Later, she is filmed against a backdrop of a space-themed wall, jumping and waving two colorful admission tickets. (5) Inside the facility, a staff member dressed in a green jumpsuit and wearing a black face mask stands before a large screen displaying a futuristic factory. She gestures with her hands as she speaks. The young girl watches attentively, later interacting with a ball pit filled with blue and white spheres to complete a task. (6) Returning to the flight simulator, the girl and woman are buckled in as the ride begins to move. The camera captures their reactions of surprise and joy. The main screen displays an animated CG world filled with floating toys, colorful liquids, and industrial machinery. (7) After the ride, the girl poses next to a yellow duck mascot against a blue wall. She holds a small prize and smiles broadly. The final shots show a toy donation bin and the girl running through the mall concourse as sunset-colored light filters through a nearby window.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: I-Ride 飛行劇院. [Variety]: 玩具星球大冒險. (2) [Slogan]: 準備起飛啦!. (3) [Slogan]: 孩子滿四歲後 就可以體驗飛行劇院. (4) [Slogan]: 現在還有親子卡 整年一大一小免費暢玩 (限平日，限量1000張). (5) [Slogan]: 親子卡申辦專區 超快速. (6) [Slogan]: 實體卡超可愛 4-12歲即可辦理 內有多項合作廠商優惠唷. (7) [Slogan]: 出發吧~. (8) [Variety]: 出發前興奮的孩子 (請記得此刻的笑容). (9) [Slogan]: 起飛前有故事導覽 我們都是地球人訪客. (10) [Slogan]: 讓一切體驗更身歷其境. (11) [Slogan]: 可以一同完成小任務. (12) [Slogan]: 互動體驗很適合大小朋友一起參與. (13) [Slogan]: 參與任務 有機會獲得小禮物唷. (14) [Slogan]: 事件發生 要準備上機囉. (15) [Slogan]: 開始體驗. (16) [Subtitle]: 結束後的允寶 還是笑嘻嘻. (17) [Slogan]: 現場也有捐玩具活動 (直到4/30). (18) [Slogan]: 喜歡的話記得收藏. 更多資訊文章內提供給大家.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer melodies. A male narrator delivers a greeting in a friendly, enthusiastic tone with a moderate-to-high pitch. The vocal delivery is clear and professionally projected. (2) A sharp whoosh sound effect marks a transition. The narrator explains membership details. The BGM remains constant in tempo, approximately 124 BPM. There is a slight background hum of a public indoor environment, but it is well-suppressed by the clean voiceover. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to include the sharp, high-pitched laughter of a child and occasional background chatter from other patrons. A digital ding UI sound effect is heard as a new promotional point is introduced. The narrator’s voice maintains a consistent, persuasive cadence. (4) The BGM continues as a rhythmic bed while several pop and bubble sound effects occur, coinciding with the interactive play scenes. The girl's vocalizations are occasional and joyful, though mostly masked by the dominant narration. (5) As the ride sequence starts, the audio mix incorporates a heavy whoosh and rumble low-frequency sound effect to simulate motion. The narrator describes the sensory experience with increased vocal arousal and a rising pitch contour. (6) The video concludes with the music fading slightly as the narrator provides a call to action. The final second features a soft sparkle sound effect over the fading pop beat, maintaining a bright and positive spectral brightness until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature -> Experience -> Social Proof -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional vlog to advertise the i-Ride Taipei 5D flight theater experience and its 2025 Parent-Child card. By showcasing a mother and daughter's joyful journey through the facility—including the membership sign-up, interactive pre-ride missions, and the actual Toy Planet ride—it aims to highlight the venue as an ideal family-friendly destination. The high-energy narration and vibrant editing emphasize the sensory excitement and emotional bonding available at the location.
